description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, a LogNode filter that processes log messages by outputting only the message content, omitting additional metadata for simplified log display.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class implementing LogNode that outputs only the message part of logs.

methods.description: Constructor accepting the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.description: Processes log entries, forwarding only the message part to the next LogNode.

methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode for the filter.
